incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1789999999 — ILB healthcheck failures observed for Private VPC deployments across eu-west1 and us-east1. Multiple customers report 502/504s. Auto-scaling/handoff triggered. Logs + metrics: https://console.re/incident/1789999999

jessie (oncall): Getting paged. seeing 502 spikes from ILBs that front privatevpc tenants. UI shows backend health=UNHEALTHY intermittently. Anyone on net/infra?

aj (sre): I'm up, looking at recent route diffs and forwardingrule churn. Correlating with a surge of auth-proxy 502s in the logs.

maria (eng-net): GCP telemetry shows backend auth-proxy upstream timeouts around 02:14-02:18Z. Looks like an auth provider rollout coincident with spike. Also seeing header-stripping on proxy->backend path.

jessie (oncall): Ok triage: 1) scope impacted customers 2) attempt fast mitigation to restore healthy backend 3) open GCP support case 4) customer comms draft.

aj (sre): Scoping: querying target-pool healthcounts now. snippet:
```
# quick counts
kubectl -n infra get endpoints ilb-auth-proxy -o yaml | grep ready | wc -l
# results: many endpoints flapping from 6 -> 0 -> 6
```
Also grepping auth-proxy logs: 
```
2026-08-12T02:15:34Z auth-proxy ERROR upstream request failed: 504 gateway timeout, token_eject=true
2026-08-12T02:15:35Z auth-proxy WARN header missing: x-rw-auth
```

maria (eng-net): I opened a GCP case (case: 123456789). GCP replied: "observed control plane retries + backend healthcheck timeouts; investigating forwarding rule retries." Asking them to check ILB health probe paths and route propagation across regions.

devon (platform): Proposed mitigation (fast):
- create a healthcheck-only route that bypasses auth for the health probe origin IPs
- temporarily reroute outbound observability agents through a different egress to reduce auth-proxy load
- add short-term rate limit for auth-proxy inbound to stop token ejection storm
Can someone run the route patch?

jessie (oncall): I'll hand to aj to run the patch. Also paging PD owners to keep watch.

aj (sre): Applying canary now:
```
rbin infra patch-route --service ilb-auth --filter "healthcheck" --allow-unauth --scope privatevpc --canary 5
# response: canary applied to 5% of healthchecks -> OK
```
Pushing to 100% in 2m if green.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by jessie (oncall); assigned to aj (sre). GCP case #123456789 created.

gcp-support: We see a burst of 5xx from the auth backend during 02:14-02:19Z. Forwarding rules briefly returned 503/504 on health probes due to upstream timeouts. We're checking control plane retries and route propagation.

maria (eng-net): Customer impact estimate so far: ~11 private VPC customers experienced failing ILB targets when auth-proxy returned errors; resulted in ~3-7% additional 5xx on their control-plane egress during the window. No sign of data loss, only connectivity degradations.

anita (cs): Copying customer success. Draft message in #customer-comms: "We're aware of connectivity disruptions for Private VPC customers in EU/US regions. Mitigation underway; we'll update in 30 minutes." @devon can you review?

devon (platform): Reviewed and OK to send after we confirm healthchecks recovering. Also enabling temporary observability sampling to avoid noise.

aj (sre): Canary looks good, rolling to 100% now. Command output:
```
applied canary -> 5% -> 100%
healthcheck success rate: 88% -> 99.6% over 3 minutes
impacting back to normal for canary group
```
Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.re/ilb/health?incident=1789999999

jessie (oncall): Seeing healthchecks stabilize. Customer 5xx rate back down to baseline for most tenants. Holding for 15m to watch for recurrence.

incident-bot: Incident severity lowered to SEV2. Paging suppressed. Please include timeline & mitigation steps in incident tracker.

maria (eng-net): Follow-up actions:
- coordinate with auth provider to find root cause of token ejection/timeout (they reported an internal deploy at 02:12Z)
- add canary rule for future auth-proxy deploys to avoid cross-region propagation hits
- refine healthprobe paths to be resilient to header stripping

aj (sre): Postmortem owner: aj. I'll draft with timeline, impact, and remediation. Tentative immediate remediations: enforce backpressure on auth-proxy, add healthcheck bypass for probe origins, add automated rollback on auth-provider error signatures.

devon (platform): Noting CS notification: anita will coordinate customer updates. Also creating follow-up ticket to evaluate whether observability agent egress needs circuit breaker.

jessie (oncall): Handoff: I'm wrapping up. Next oncall @maria in 20m — please monitor the ILB health dashboard. Leaving notes in incident tracker and flagging for postmortem.

anita (cs): Sending customer note now. Template included. Will update customers when postmortem ready.

gcp-support: Case updated: GCP control plane saw transient forwarding-rule propagation delays concurrent with upstream auth timeouts. No persistent network fabric failures detected. Recommend coordinating with auth provider for rolling updates and verifying health probe resilience.

aj (sre): Incident closed for active remediation; will keep postmortem open. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents log. Closing active paging for this incident."
